notes: The schema observatory's @antv/g6 chunk (~1384 kB) is a deliberate, lazy, out-of-band cost: it is double-lazied behind /reference/entities and never enters the entry graph. The total is sized to leave the UI/UX overhaul room to add primitives without renegotiating the budget every phase; the entry chunk itself is the number worth watching, and route-level splitting keeps it well under.
